entries.speaker: Lavenza's Voice
entries.en: It seems you have managed to save all of[n]your teammates...

entries.speaker: Lavenza's Voice
entries.en: Now then, please gather in this room[n]at once.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, what was that voice? Wait...[n]You've already rescued everyone?
Not Morgana.
I have.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Whaddya mean?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-Hey, does that mean you found[n]Morgana? He was actin' kinda weird[n]before...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wh-What was that voice!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait... So you already saved everyone[n]else other than me?
Not Morgana.
I have.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? Why?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: H-Hey, how's Mona?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He was acting weird ever since we went[n]into Mementos. I've been worried about[n]him...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Actually, it'd be faster to go see him for[n]myself. Let's go meet up with everyone!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Wh-What was that voice? Joker, have[n]you already rescued the others?
Not Morgana.
I have.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? Then what of Mona?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Did you find Mona as well? He was acting[n]somewhat odd before...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In any case, let us go meet up with the[n]others. We can speak more there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh? Whose voice was that?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Joker, did you already rescue the others?
Not Morgana.
I did.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mona? What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, did you find Morgana here as well?[n]I've been concerned about him. He was[n]acting quite odd...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, it seems we can discuss that more[n]once we meet up with everyone else.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...What was up with that voice?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I mean, was I the last one?
I couldn't find Morgana.
You are.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What do you mean, you "couldn't find[n]him"?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Th-Then does that mean you found[n]Mona too? Was he okay?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wait, I can check that for myself when I[n]see him. We gotta go back and regroup[n]with everyone first!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hm? What was that voice?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Joker, have you already rescued all the[n]others?
Not Morgana.
I have.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh? You couldn't find Mona-chan?[n]But why?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, then did you find Mona-chan too?[n]I've been worried about him. He was[n]acting so strange before...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Anyway, let's go regroup with everyone!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's go!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's up this way. Follow me!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's go, Joker!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We can do this, I know we can!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's this? It's one hell of a door...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's our exit. Come on, let's go.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Please be careful on your way.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, we should leave this place for now.[n]I'm curious about how things are looking[n]outside.
